title: Let’s repeat what we learned
intro: Manners, the blessed days, the two Eids – let’s repeat!

learn.html: Let’s repeat! Say the missing words with your muallim:

items: Islamic manners mean saying the right ______ in different situations. In every situation we thank Allah with ______.
Before eating we say ______, and after eating we thank Allah with ______.
Besides the four blessed days, Muslims also mark ______ blessed nights.
Eid al-Fitr is ______ blessed days after ______, the joy of having ______. On the first morning we go to the masjid to pray the ______.
Eid al-Adha is ______ blessed days of ______. In these days Muslims do the rites of ______, ______ and the takbirs of tashriq.

questions.q: How many blessed days are there?
How many blessed nights do Muslims mark?

practice.title: Say it
prompts: 🗣️ Name the four blessed days and their dates.
